scenario: When a new registration arrives in the Zoom webinar, the agent looks up the registrant in HubSpot, creates or updates the contact with the webinar's campaign tag, and adds them to the reminder email list. Registrants from target accounts are posted to the #abm-alerts Slack channel.
rule_hooks: target account list, dedupe-by-email rule

scenario: When a HubSpot contact's lead score crosses the MQL threshold, the agent sets the lifecycle stage to MQL, creates a Salesforce lead assigned by territory, and DMs the assigned SDR with the contact's recent engagement.
rule_hooks: score threshold, territory routing table

scenario: When a contact replies 'unsubscribe' or 'remove me' to a campaign email in the Gmail inbox, the agent adds them to the global suppression list in the email platform, unchecks marketing consent in HubSpot, and logs the request in the compliance sheet.
rule_hooks: consent/GDPR handling policy, suppression scope

scenario: When the trade-show team uploads a badge-scan CSV to the shared Drive folder, the agent dedupes it against Salesforce, creates new leads with the event campaign as source, and attaches them to the event campaign with 'Attended Booth' status.
rule_hooks: dedupe rules, campaign member status values

scenario: When the daily ad-spend sheet shows a Google Ads campaign over its pacing target, the agent pauses the campaign if it is over 120% of plan, otherwise flags it in the budget tracker, and notifies the paid-media owner in Slack.
rule_hooks: pacing thresholds, per-channel budget caps

scenario: When a blog post's status changes to Published in the content calendar (Asana), the agent schedules social posts on LinkedIn and X from the approved copy, adds the URL to the next newsletter draft, and marks the promotion task done.
rule_hooks: promotion checklist by content type

scenario: When a product manager submits the content request form, the agent creates a ticket in the content team's Jira board with priority and an owner based on content type, adds it to the editorial calendar sheet, and confirms the due date to the requester by email.
rule_hooks: SLA by content type, writer assignment matrix

scenario: When a lead downloads a gated whitepaper via a HubSpot form, the agent enrolls them in the matching nurture sequence, updates the lead's 'content interest' property, and alerts the account owner if the lead's company is an open opportunity in Salesforce.
rule_hooks: asset-to-nurture mapping, open-opportunity check

scenario: When a DocuSign influencer agreement is completed, the agent updates the influencer's row in the partnership tracker to Contracted, creates the deliverable tasks in Monday.com with the contracted post dates, and emails finance the payment schedule.
rule_hooks: contract terms, payment milestone schedule

scenario: When the marketing director approves a campaign brief in the approval Slack thread, the agent moves the campaign in the project board to In Production, creates the Salesforce campaign record with budget and dates, and notifies the creative and ops leads.
rule_hooks: approval authority by budget level

scenario: When a webinar ends, the agent pulls the Zoom attendee report, marks registrants as Attended or No-show in the Salesforce campaign, and sends no-shows the on-demand recording email while attendees get the follow-up survey.
rule_hooks: attendance minimum duration, follow-up template by status

scenario: When the social listening tool posts a mention tagged negative with high reach, the agent creates an Intercom/Zendesk ticket for support if it's a product complaint or escalates to the comms lead in Slack if it's PR-sensitive, and logs it in the brand monitoring sheet.
rule_hooks: reach threshold, escalation categories

scenario: When a channel partner emails a request for market development funds for a joint event, the agent checks the partner's remaining MDF balance in the partner sheet, creates the request in the approval tracker, and replies with eligibility or the shortfall.
rule_hooks: MDF tier allocations, eligible activity types

scenario: When someone posts a request in #campaign-links for a tracked link, the agent builds the UTM URL using the naming convention, logs it in the UTM registry sheet, and replies in the thread with the shortened link.
rule_hooks: UTM naming taxonomy, approved source/medium values

scenario: When a sponsorship invoice from an event organizer arrives by email, the agent matches it to the committed amount in the events budget sheet, creates a bill in QuickBooks coded to the event's GL class, and requests approval from the budget owner if it exceeds the commitment.
rule_hooks: budget commitments, variance tolerance, GL coding

scenario: When a press release's embargo time is reached per the PR calendar, the agent publishes the newsroom page status, sends the release to the media list in Mailchimp, and posts the announcement links to #company-news.
rule_hooks: embargo schedule, media list segments

scenario: When a customer returns a signed case-study release via DocuSign, the agent updates the customer's Salesforce account with 'Reference Approved', moves the case study draft to Design in the content board, and notifies the customer marketing manager.
rule_hooks: reference permission levels (logo, quote, full story)

scenario: When a campaign send completes, the agent reads the hard-bounce report, marks those contacts as invalid in HubSpot, removes them from active lists, and flags the list owner if the bounce rate exceeds the deliverability threshold.
rule_hooks: bounce rate threshold, hard vs soft bounce rule

scenario: When a demo request form is submitted on the website, the agent enriches the company size from the form, routes enterprise leads to the AE round-robin and SMB leads to the inside-sales queue in Salesforce, and books a Calendly link reply.
rule_hooks: segment by employee count, round-robin roster

scenario: When a registration for an in-person customer dinner would exceed venue capacity in the event sheet, the agent places the registrant on the waitlist, sends them the waitlist email, and alerts the event manager if a target-account VIP was waitlisted.
rule_hooks: venue capacity, VIP priority list

scenario: When a confirmed attendee cancels an in-person workshop by email, the agent marks them Cancelled in the event campaign, promotes the next waitlisted registrant, and sends the promoted person a confirmation with calendar invite.
rule_hooks: waitlist ordering, cancellation cutoff

scenario: When a sales rep submits a brand asset request in the helpdesk portal, the agent checks the asset library sheet for an approved version, replies with the link if one exists or creates a design ticket if not, and closes or assigns the request.
rule_hooks: approved asset catalog, brand usage rules

scenario: When the competitive intel inbox receives an alert that a competitor changed pricing, the agent updates the battlecard tracker row, creates a task for the product marketer owning that competitor, and posts a summary to #competitive.
rule_hooks: competitor ownership matrix

scenario: When a newsletter signup's double opt-in confirmation is received, the agent sets the subscription status and region-specific consent fields in HubSpot, adds them to the regional newsletter list, and sends the welcome email.
rule_hooks: regional consent rules, list by country

scenario: When a LinkedIn Lead Gen form is submitted, the agent creates the contact in HubSpot with original source set to Paid Social and the campaign ID, adds them to the campaign's Salesforce campaign, and alerts the owner if the company is an existing customer.
rule_hooks: attribution source mapping, customer-account check

scenario: When a Salesforce opportunity moves to Closed Won, the agent reads the contact roles' campaign touches, records first- and last-touch campaigns on the opportunity, and appends the deal to the marketing-sourced revenue sheet.
rule_hooks: attribution model, touch lookback window

scenario: When a customer submits a speaker proposal for the user conference, the agent logs it in the CFP review sheet, assigns two reviewers by track, and sends the submitter an acknowledgement with the decision date.
rule_hooks: track assignment, reviewer conflict rules

scenario: When a new G2 review notification arrives, the agent logs it in the reviews tracker, sends a thank-you incentive gift card request for 4-5 star reviews, and opens a support ticket plus CSM alert for reviews of 3 stars or below.
rule_hooks: rating thresholds, incentive policy

scenario: When an event lead requests a swag shipment for an upcoming booth via the request form, the agent checks inventory in the swag sheet, creates the order with the fulfillment vendor by email, and decrements inventory or flags shortages.
rule_hooks: inventory levels, per-event swag allowance

scenario: When an English campaign asset is marked Final in the content tracker, the agent creates translation tasks for each target market listed on the campaign, notifies the localization vendor with deadlines, and adds the language versions to the tracker.
rule_hooks: market-language mapping, vendor turnaround SLA

scenario: When the intent tool flags a surge for a target account, the agent updates the account's ABM tier field in Salesforce, adds the account's contacts to the retargeting audience sheet, and notifies the account's AE and SDR in Slack.
rule_hooks: ABM tier criteria, intent score bands

scenario: When Meta Ads emails that an ad was rejected for policy, the agent marks the creative Rejected in the ad tracker, creates a revision task for the designer with the policy reason, and notifies the paid-media manager of the affected campaign.
rule_hooks: ad policy categories, creative owner mapping

scenario: When a privacy request to delete personal data arrives at the privacy inbox, the agent finds the person in HubSpot, the email platform, and the event sheets, deletes or anonymizes the records, and logs completion with dates in the DSAR register.
rule_hooks: DSAR deadlines, retention exceptions

scenario: When a free trial signup appears in the product database export, the agent creates the HubSpot contact with the trial plan, enrolls them in the persona-specific onboarding sequence, and creates a Salesforce task for sales if the signup uses a corporate domain from a target account.
rule_hooks: persona mapping by job title, free-email domain list

scenario: When a campaign's end date passes in the campaign calendar, the agent pulls leads, opportunities, and spend for the campaign from Salesforce and the budget sheet, writes the cost-per-lead and ROI into the results sheet, and emails the summary to the campaign owner.
rule_hooks: KPI definitions, target benchmarks

scenario: When the creative agency's monthly invoice arrives in Xero inbox, the agent compares billed hours against the retainer cap in the agency SOW sheet, approves it within the cap, or holds it and emails the agency manager with the overage.
rule_hooks: retainer cap, overage approval policy

scenario: When a new podcast episode goes live on the hosting platform, the agent adds it to the content library sheet with the guest and topic, emails the guest a share kit, and schedules the episode promo posts.
rule_hooks: guest share kit templates, social posting schedule

scenario: When an SDR changes a Salesforce lead status to Rejected with a reason, the agent sets the lead back to Nurture in HubSpot, enrolls them in the recycle nurture, and logs the rejection reason in the lead quality sheet for the campaign that sourced it.
rule_hooks: rejection reason codes, recycle eligibility

scenario: When the events calendar shows a venue contract's attrition or cancellation deadline within seven days, the agent checks current registrations against the room block, emails the venue to release rooms if under the threshold, and alerts the event manager.
rule_hooks: room block attrition clause, registration threshold

scenario: When an NPS survey response of 9 or 10 comes in, the agent tags the contact as Promoter in HubSpot, adds them to the advocacy program invite list, and notifies customer marketing unless the account has an open escalation in Zendesk.
rule_hooks: NPS score bands, open-escalation exclusion

scenario: Product management moves a feature launch date in the project tool. The agent finds all linked campaign assets in the marketing calendar sheet, reschedules the queued launch emails and social posts, and notifies the agency and sales enablement in Slack.
rule_hooks: dependency map of assets per launch, minimum lead times per channel

scenario: A sales rep emails asking for a discount code for a prospect cohort tied to a campaign. The agent checks the discount policy, creates the code in the billing or ecommerce tool, logs it in the promo tracker sheet, and replies with the code and its expiry.
rule_hooks: discount ceiling by deal size, approval tiers, max active codes per campaign

scenario: A rep shares a spreadsheet of contacts collected at a third-party conference and asks to add them to the newsletter. The agent checks each row's consent source and region, imports compliant rows to HubSpot with the right lead source, and replies listing the rejected rows and the reasons.
rule_hooks: consent evidence requirements by country (GDPR/CASL), allowed lead sources

scenario: Google Ads emails that the account's card was declined and campaigns will pause. The agent checks the campaign priority list, files a payment request with finance using the backup-card procedure, and alerts the paid media owner about which live campaigns are at risk.
rule_hooks: payment fallback policy, campaign priority tiers

scenario: A Zoom webinar ends with unanswered Q&A questions in the export. The agent matches each asker to a CRM contact, routes product questions to the product marketing SME and buying-intent questions to the account owner as tasks, and logs everything in the follow-up sheet.
rule_hooks: question topic to owner mapping, buying-intent keywords

scenario: A new form fill creates a lead whose email domain and name match an existing Salesforce contact. The agent applies the dedupe rules, merges the lead into the existing record or converts it to that account, keeps the original lead source, and notifies the owner.
rule_hooks: match keys and survivorship rules, which fields to preserve on merge

scenario: A hot lead's assigned rep returns an out-of-office auto-reply to the routing notification. The agent reads the return date, reassigns the lead to the next rep in round robin if the absence exceeds the SLA, and posts the handoff in the sales channel.
rule_hooks: response SLA by lead grade, round-robin order and pod membership

scenario: Sales ops announces that a rep is leaving at the end of the week. The agent finds the rep's open marketing-sourced leads and active nurture sequences, reassigns them by territory, and updates the sequence sender in the email tool.
rule_hooks: territory assignment table, sequence sender rules

scenario: A post-event survey response arrives with a low rating and a complaint about the venue or a session. The agent logs it in the event feedback sheet, alerts the event manager in Slack, and, if the respondent is a customer, creates a task for their CSM.
rule_hooks: rating threshold, complaint category to owner, customer vs prospect status

scenario: An asset in the content inventory reaches its review date because its statistics are older than the policy allows. The agent emails the owner, sets the asset status to 'needs refresh', and removes it from active nurture emails until it is updated.
rule_hooks: content freshness policy by asset type, nurture inclusion rules

scenario: A copywriter marks ad copy ready in the project tool, and the copy contains a superlative or comparative claim. The agent flags the claim, opens a legal review ticket with the substantiation request, and holds the task's go-live date.
rule_hooks: claims policy keyword list, substantiation requirements, legal SLA

scenario: A team member reports that a reseller's website uses the outdated company logo and wrong product name. The agent looks up the partner's manager in the CRM, sends the current brand kit link and guideline excerpt, and logs a compliance case with a follow-up date.
rule_hooks: brand usage guidelines, partner tier and escalation timeline

scenario: Finance announces a list-price change effective next month. The agent searches the collateral library sheet for every asset that mentions the old prices, creates refresh tasks for the owners with the deadline, and notifies sales enablement which decks to stop using.
rule_hooks: price-bearing asset tags, effective-date deadline rules

scenario: HR emails that a new marketing hire starts Monday with a given role. The agent checks the role access matrix, files access requests for HubSpot, the ads accounts, Canva and the analytics tools, and adds the person to the right Slack channels and team calendar.
rule_hooks: role-based access matrix, seat license limits

scenario: The design agency uploads a batch of display ad creatives and emails that they are done. The agent checks the file sizes, dimensions and naming against the brief's spec sheet, logs the deliverables, and replies listing any non-conforming files.
rule_hooks: ad network spec table, naming convention, brief deliverable list

scenario: A contact replies to an SMS campaign with a keyword such as DEMO, INFO or PRICING. The agent updates the contact's engagement properties, routes demo requests to the account owner with a task, and sends the matching auto-reply.
rule_hooks: keyword to action mapping, quiet hours by timezone

scenario: A journalist emails the press inbox asking for comment on an industry story with a deadline. The agent logs the inquiry in the media tracker, picks the spokesperson by topic, and pings the PR lead in Slack with the outlet tier and deadline.
rule_hooks: spokesperson by topic, outlet tier, response deadline urgency

scenario: An industry analyst firm emails requesting a briefing for an upcoming report. The agent checks the analyst relations calendar and the firm's priority, schedules a call with product marketing and the relevant PM, and drafts the prep doc task.
rule_hooks: analyst firm priority list, required attendees by report type

scenario: An industry awards body emails that the company is shortlisted for an award. The agent adds the ceremony to the PR calendar, checks the awards rules on announcing before the results, and creates social and blog tasks with the permitted publish dates.
rule_hooks: award embargo rules, announcement templates by award tier

scenario: An analytics alert shows that form-conversion events dropped to zero on the main landing pages. The agent checks which ad campaigns optimize on that conversion, pauses or switches the bid strategy per the playbook, and opens a ticket for the web team.
rule_hooks: outage duration thresholds, campaign bid strategy playbook

scenario: An opportunity closes won in Salesforce. The agent removes the account's contacts from prospect nurture and retargeting audiences, enrolls them in the customer onboarding newsletter, and updates their lifecycle stage.
rule_hooks: lifecycle stage definitions, list exclusion rules

scenario: Customer success marks an account as churned with a churn reason. The agent removes the contacts from customer-only communications, schedules them into the win-back campaign after the cooldown period, and excludes them if the reason is non-payment.
rule_hooks: churn reason to eligibility, cooldown window

scenario: A confirmed conference speaker emails that they have to cancel. The agent updates the agenda sheet and event site task list, offers the slot to the first available backup speaker, and emails registrants of that session if the change is within the notice window.
rule_hooks: backup speaker bench order, registrant notice window

scenario: An event sponsor's signed agreement and logo files arrive. The agent looks up the package tier, creates fulfillment tasks for each entitled benefit (logo placement, booth, email mention, speaking slot), and confirms the asset deadlines to the sponsor.
rule_hooks: sponsorship package entitlement table, asset deadlines

scenario: A channel partner submits a market development fund claim with proof of performance and an invoice. The agent checks the partner's remaining MDF balance and the pre-approved activity, approves or rejects the claim, updates the MDF ledger, and notifies the partner manager.
rule_hooks: MDF balance, eligible activity types, proof-of-performance requirements

scenario: An attendee emails asking for photos of them from a company event to be taken down. The agent finds the photos in the event gallery tracker, flags them for removal from the website and social, logs the request, and confirms to the attendee.
rule_hooks: photo consent policy, removal SLA

scenario: A customer posts a positive video about the product on social, and the community manager flags it. The agent sends the content rights request, logs it in the UGC tracker with permitted uses, and notifies the content team once rights are granted.
rule_hooks: content license terms, permitted channel uses

scenario: Investor relations announces the start of the earnings quiet period. The agent finds the scheduled press releases, social posts and campaign emails with forward-looking or financial content in that window, holds them, and notifies the owners with the release date.
rule_hooks: quiet period dates, restricted content categories

scenario: A demo request arrives from a contact whose company is in a sanctioned or embargoed country. The agent blocks routing, sets a compliance status on the lead, removes it from nurture, and notifies the compliance contact.
rule_hooks: sanctioned country list, compliance escalation contacts

scenario: A product marketer adds a new webinar to the marketing calendar. The agent creates the Zoom webinar, sends panelist invitations to the speakers, creates the registration landing page task, and adds the webinar to the campaign tracker with the right campaign ID.
rule_hooks: webinar setup checklist, campaign naming convention

scenario: A marketer schedules a new email send to a segment. The agent checks the send calendar for other sends to overlapping lists within the frequency cap window, and either confirms the schedule or moves it and notifies both campaign owners.
rule_hooks: contact frequency cap, send priority by campaign type

scenario: The direct mail vendor sends a file of returned, undeliverable packages from a campaign. The agent marks the mailing addresses invalid in the CRM, asks the account owners to verify high-value contacts, and adjusts the campaign cost-per-delivery in the tracker.
rule_hooks: address status codes, high-value account threshold

scenario: A content syndication vendor delivers its weekly lead batch. The agent checks each lead against the contract criteria (title, company size, region, no duplicates), imports qualifying leads, and emails the vendor a credit request for the rejects.
rule_hooks: vendor contract lead criteria, cost per lead, dedupe rules

scenario: Google Postmaster or the ESP reports that the spam complaint rate on the marketing domain crossed a threshold. The agent pauses the low-engagement sends, restricts the next sends to engaged segments, and alerts the email ops lead.
rule_hooks: spam rate thresholds, engagement tier definitions

scenario: A sales rep asks if they may put a customer's logo in a pitch deck. The agent checks the customer's logo permission status in the advocacy sheet and contract notes, replies with approval and the approved file, or starts a permission request with the CSM.
rule_hooks: logo permission status, allowed usage contexts

scenario: The event manager assigns staff to work a trade show booth. The agent sends each person the booth schedule, opens travel requests within per-diem policy, books them into the hotel block, and adds the shifts to their calendars.
rule_hooks: travel policy limits, hotel block cutoff date, shift coverage rules

scenario: A deal sourced through the customer referral program closes won. The agent looks up the referrer, picks the reward by deal size tier, issues the gift card or account credit request, and emails the referrer a thank-you.
rule_hooks: referral reward tiers, eligibility (existing customers only, payout caps)

scenario: The SEO tool alerts that a high-traffic page dropped several positions for its target keyword. The agent checks the page's priority in the keyword tracker, opens a content refresh ticket with the competing URLs, and notifies the content owner.
rule_hooks: keyword priority tiers, ranking drop threshold

scenario: A social media giveaway closes. The agent filters the entries against the contest eligibility rules, draws a winner, emails them to confirm and collect a shipping address, logs the prize in the swag tracker, and schedules the winner announcement post.
rule_hooks: contest eligibility rules (region, employees excluded), claim deadline

scenario: A sales leader emails a revised list of target accounts for next quarter. The agent adds the new accounts to the ABM tier in the CRM and the ad audiences, removes the dropped ones, excludes current customers and open-opportunity conflicts, and posts the change summary.
rule_hooks: ABM tier criteria, exclusion lists, audience size minimums
